title: genista cinerea subsp. jimenezii
intro: Genista cinerea subsp. jimenezii, commonly known as Spanish broom, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family. It is known for its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which have been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Genista cinerea subsp. jimenezii include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, prevent cancer, and protect against cardiovascular disease. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, coumarins, and alkaloids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
